# Francisco Varisco

> Francisco Varisco is a Brazilian-born, Australia-based technologist with 20 years of experience across five startups. He is the founder of MOAT Studio, an AI consultancy in Brisbane, and a Member of Technical Staff at Askable Labs, building human data to power the next generation of AI models.

Francisco (also known as Xico) writes about AI systems, agents, and the infrastructure of working with them — including running always-on local agents and coding labs at home. Previous roles include Head of AI and founding engineer at Askable, engineering manager at Fupay, and co-founder of Yoom.

## Site

- [Homepage](https://franciscovarisco.com/): bio, work history, side projects, and contact links
- [Blog](https://franciscovarisco.com/blog): writing on AI systems, agents, and opinions

## Writing

- [Humans came second](https://franciscovarisco.com/blog/humans-came-second/): what running a first voice eval taught him about synthetic speech, human judgement, and the data models still need
- [Build the factory first](https://franciscovarisco.com/blog/build-the-factory-first/): what a coding lab at home actually gives you, and what it costs to set one up
- [Don't code yourself a website](https://franciscovarisco.com/blog/how-i-built-this-website/): from empty repo to a live site in an afternoon, built by describing what he wanted
